judged.why: as a texture reference: the rule's first (inat_88095389, local) shows the snake small and far on a road; this one shows the whole body large and clear, dark with a yellow dorsal stripe and yellow side stripes, no red (the first photo used, commons_2913910, was a coastal red-spotted form, before the local rule)
